content: Kriti Mahajan confirms receipt of the policy renewal form and payment link from Karan Joshi. She inquires about payment confirmation, and Karan explains that she will receive a confirmation email from the payment gateway and a follow-up email once the policy status is updated. Kriti needs to complete the payment and return the form by the end of the month to reinstate her policy.

action_items: Customer to settle the outstanding payment and return the renewal form by the end of the month
Agent to update policy status and send a follow-up confirmation email after payment
